text:
I think the first elected mayor of Kathmandu in 1953 was Rajeshwar Devkota, chosen by the council. I'm recalling this from memory and haven't verified it. The team note naming B.P. Koirala doesn't match what I remember, since he was a national political leader and not a Kathmandu mayor. My earlier guess of Padma Ratna Tuladhar also looks wrong.

CONFIDENCE: 55
